tools.name: search_sellers
tools.description: Search the Handshakr suppliers an AI agent may read, by keyword and optional category. Returns name, slug, category, location, description and `contactable`: true only for suppliers who have switched agent access on, the only ones an agent may approach. Claimed suppliers who have not consented are n

tools.name: get_seller
tools.description: Fetch one Handshakr supplier an AI agent may read, by slug. `contactable` says whether the supplier has switched agent access on and may be approached. `description` and `category` are the company's own words or null; text Handshakr wrote from public sources is in `handshakr_summary` / `handshakr_ca

tools.name: get_public_pulse
tools.description: Recent public activity in the Handshakr register: suppliers newly published and source pulse events. Only suppliers an AI agent may read are named.

tools.name: get_trending_categories
tools.description: Top trending supplier categories among the suppliers an AI agent may read, this week vs last week, with delta percentage. Returns available:false with a reason when too few recently published profiles are categorised to compute a trend, an empty result is never a silent zero.
